name: Smarto AI Customer Support Chatbot, Helpdesk & Support Tickets
author: Shahadat

sections.description:
Smarto AI Customer Support adds an AI support chatbot to your WordPress site that knows your business. It answers visitors from your pages, posts, products, courses and the documents you add, any time of day and in their own language. When a question needs a person, it creates a support ticket for your team, so no customer is left without an answer.

It is a customer service chatbot and a helpdesk in one plugin, running on your own site with your own AI key. No account with us, no per-seat pricing, and your conversations stay in your WordPress database.

Setup guides, every setting explained and fixes for common problems: documentation.

Key features

  • AI chatbot that answers only from your own content and says so when it does not know.
  • Replies in the visitor’s language and writing style, with no translation plugin.
  • WooCommerce help: live stock and prices, product cards, shipping, policies, the visitor’s cart, the customer’s own orders, and the store coupons you allow.
  • Tutor LMS and LearnPress help: course search, course details and each student’s progress.
  • Built-in helpdesk with support tickets, email replies, private notes and a private reply page for customers.
  • Stays on topic: off-topic chat, homework and prompt tricks are refused, and misuse is paused.
  • Visitor details and orders next to every conversation, so your team knows who they are helping.
  • Works with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible server.
  • Guided setup in a few minutes, with a live preview of the chat widget, and opening hours for the whole week in one step.
  • Fill from my website: the AI reads your home, About and Contact pages and fills your business profile and opening hours for you to check.

It is built for every kind of WordPress site. It reads what your site offers, so a shop never talks about courses and a blog never talks about shipping.

Online stores (WooCommerce)

“Is this in stock?”, “Where is my order?” and “How much is shipping?” get an accurate answer in seconds: products, live prices and stock, variations, shipping options, store policies, the visitor’s own cart, and the customer’s own orders and tracking. Private order details stay protected.

Asked about discounts, it shares only the store coupons you allow (none, all active ones, or the ones you pick), explains the conditions such as minimum spend, expiry and sale items, and checks whether a coupon works for the product the visitor is looking at. Coupon descriptions stay private, so you can keep internal notes there.

This short video shows a store assistant answering stock, order and shipping questions:

Service businesses

Services, published prices, opening hours (“are you open now?”), location, service area, and quote or booking requests that reach your team as tickets.

See it on a service business site:

Course sites (Tutor LMS, LearnPress)

The course catalog, what a course covers, and a logged-in student’s own enrollment and progress. Lesson content and quiz answers are never shared.

Watch how it helps students without giving away quiz answers:

Blogs, documentation and membership sites

Answers from your published content, with links to the source pages, and account help for logged-in members.

Speaks your visitors’ language

The assistant replies in the language each visitor writes in, even when your content is in another language. It also follows mixed styles, such as Bangla or Hindi typed in English letters. There is nothing to set up and no translation plugin to install.

Support only, by design

The assistant only helps with questions about your business. It politely refuses coding help, homework, essays, general knowledge questions and attempts to change its rules, so nobody can use your AI budget as a free chatbot.

  • A quick scope check labels each message and refuses off-topic requests before the full answer is written, which also saves AI tokens.
  • Repeated misuse ends the chat.
  • Message length, messages per minute, chats per day, and daily or monthly token limits.
  • A built-in scope tester runs common misuse prompts against your settings.

Private data stays private

  • Visitors only see public information or their own data. Who the visitor is comes from WordPress (their login), never from what the AI says.
  • Guests can check an order with the order number, the billing email and a one-time code sent to that email.
  • Order details shared with the AI never include addresses, phone numbers, emails or payment details.
  • Lesson and quiz content is never used, and the assistant never gives quiz or exam answers.
  • The assistant never shares staff details, other customers’ data or how your site is built.
  • It can only read pages of your own site, never other websites.

Knowledge

  • Choose which post types are used: all, only the ones you tick in the editor, or none.
  • Upload Markdown, text, CSV, HTML or Word (.docx) files. Only the text is kept.
  • Paste text or add questions and answers.
  • Learns what to add next: every question the assistant could not answer is collected in one list, so you answer each one once and the knowledge gap closes for good.
  • Content is re-indexed automatically when you save a post.

Your team stays in control

The assistant covers nights and weekends. Anything it cannot answer waits for your team as a ticket, with the full chat attached, so you start the morning knowing exactly what customers need.

  • A ticket inbox: open, waiting on customer and closed views, search, filters and bulk actions.
  • Reply to customers by email right from the ticket, and keep private notes for your team.
  • Customers get a reference number, a confirmation email and a private page to answer you; your team gets an email for each new ticket.
  • Full transcripts that show which tools the assistant used, on a clear screen with the visitor, the conversation, tickets and orders in separate cards.
  • Smart chat names: the AI names each chat after what the visitor needs, such as “Refund for a damaged watch”, instead of “Hi”. Rename any chat yourself.
  • Visitor details on each chat: country, local time, browser, system, device and language.
  • WooCommerce orders next to the chat, only for a logged-in customer or an order confirmed with the emailed code.
  • Dashboard with conversations, handoffs, ratings, helpful votes, blocked misuse and AI usage.
  • An optional “AI + human support. AI can make mistakes.” note under the chat, which opens the Message the team form.
  • Buttons for other ways to reach you: WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, phone, email or any link. They are plain links, nothing is tracked.
  • Skills: step by step instructions in plain language, such as how to handle returns or quote requests. Edit the built-in ones or write your own.

A chat widget your visitors will use

  • Brand color, left or right position, avatar styles or your own image, and an icon or labeled button, with a live preview before you save.
  • Welcome message and suggested questions written for your kind of site, or your own.
  • Product and course cards in the chat, linked to the page.
  • Visitors can read and continue their past conversations, rate a chat and end it.
  • A Message the team form that is always one tap away.
  • Optional consent before chatting, and an “AI + human support” note.
  • Full screen on phones, keyboard friendly, with screen reader labels.
  • Drawn in its own isolated layer, so your theme or page builder cannot break it.
  • Hide it on chosen post types or pages, show it to logged-in users only, or place it inside a page with a shortcode.

AI providers

Bring your own API key from OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Google Gemini, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible server. You pay the provider directly, and daily or monthly token limits keep usage under your control. Keys are stored encrypted. A searchable model list shows every model your key can use.

Pro

Smarto AI Customer Support Pro is a separate, optional plugin sold on wpsmarto.com. It adds live chat with your team (with files, product and coupon sharing, and the visitor’s cart), conversation tags, customer email replies and files into tickets, saved replies, ticket assignment and response times, team reports, CSV export, page greetings, opening hours for the chat button and custom widget text. This plugin works fully without it, with no account, license or time limit.

External services

Smarto AI Customer Support connects to a third-party AI service only after you add your own API key, and only to the provider you select. Your API keys are stored encrypted on your site and are sent only to that provider.

AI providers

The assistant needs an AI provider to write its replies. You choose one in Settings, AI provider. Nothing is sent until you add an API key and either turn on the chat widget or use the test chat.

What is sent and when:

  • Each time a visitor sends a chat message: the conversation so far, the assistant’s instructions, your business profile, the parts of your knowledge that match the question, the list of tools the assistant can use, and the results of those tools (for example product details, or an order status without addresses, phone numbers, emails or payment details).
  • When the scope check is on: the visitor’s latest message and a few earlier ones, in a short separate request that checks the message is about your business.
  • To name a chat: after one of the visitor’s first five messages, a short separate request with the chat so far, so the team sees a name such as “Refund for a damaged watch”. It stops once the chat has a name.
  • When an administrator clicks Fill from my website (Settings, Business, or the setup guide): the site name and tagline, the WooCommerce store address if set, and the text of the home page and up to five public pages such as About and Contact, to suggest the business profile. Nothing is sent until the button is clicked.
  • When you click Test connection or load the model list in Settings: your API key, to read the provider’s model list and send a short test prompt.

Supported providers:

  • OpenAI (api.openai.com): Services agreement, Terms of use, Privacy policy
  • Anthropic (Claude) (api.anthropic.com): Commercial terms, Privacy policy
  • Google Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com): Gemini API terms, Privacy policy
  • OpenRouter (openrouter.ai): Terms of service, Privacy policy. Your site address is also sent as the referrer and the plugin name as the app title, as OpenRouter asks apps to do.
  • Custom provider: if you enter the address of your own OpenAI-compatible server, the same data is sent to that address. Its terms and privacy policy are set by whoever runs that server.

Emails

New tickets, confirmations to customers and your replies are sent through your site’s own email setup (wp_mail). The plugin does not contact any email service itself.

Contact buttons

If you add WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, phone, email or other links in Settings, Chat widget, they show as plain links. The plugin sends nothing to those services. A visitor who taps one leaves for that app or site, and its own terms and privacy policy apply.

Visitor country

The country shown on a conversation comes from a header your CDN adds (such as Cloudflare) or from WooCommerce’s own location lookup, with its outside lookups turned off. The plugin does not call any location service.

WP Smarto

The plugin does not send any data to WP Smarto, the plugin author, and has no tracking or analytics. Links to wpsmarto.com on the Settings screen are plain links that open in your browser.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. A short setup guide opens and walks you through the AI provider, your business and the chat widget. Once the AI is connected, Fill from my website fills your business details from your own pages.
  2. Or set it up by hand: go to AI Support, Settings, AI provider. Add an API key, choose a model and click Test connection.
  3. Fill in Assistant and Business, or click Fill from my website on the Business screen.
  4. Go to AI Support, Knowledge and choose your content, upload documents or add questions and answers.
  5. Try it in AI Support, Test chat and run the scope tester.
  6. Turn on the chat in Settings, Chat widget.

You can open the setup guide again from AI Support, Dashboard.
sections.faq:
Is it free? Do I need an account?

The plugin is free and every feature in it works without an account, license or time limit. You only need an API key from an AI provider, and you pay the provider for what you use.

Which AI provider should I use?

Any of them works. Fast, low-cost models are a good fit for support. You can set daily and monthly token limits, and change the provider or model at any time without losing your setup.

Will it make things up?

It is told to answer only from your content, your business profile and live store data, and to say plainly when it does not know. It then offers to pass the question to your team, and the question appears in your unanswered list so you can add the answer.

Can people use it as a free ChatGPT?

No. A quick check labels each message first. Homework, coding, essays and anything unrelated to your business are refused in one sentence, and visitors who keep trying are paused for the time you choose. Those messages never reach the main model.

Which languages does it support?

The language your visitor writes in. Your content can be in one language and visitors can ask in another.

What happens when the AI cannot help?

It collects the details and asks the visitor to confirm, then creates a support ticket. The visitor gets a reference number and a confirmation email, and your team gets an email. You reply from the ticket, and the customer answers from a private page.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The chat script loads after your page and only talks to your server when a visitor opens the chat.

Does it work with page caching?

Yes. Pages hold no nonce or session data. The chat gets a signed session when a visitor opens it.

Can I put the chat inside a page?

Yes. Use the shortcode [smartoaics_chat], for example on a Help page.

Can my own buttons open the chat?

Yes. Link to #smartoaics-open, or add the class smartoaics-open to any button. Add data-smartoaics-message=”Your question” to send a question right away. Developers can call SmartoaicsWidget.open(), SmartoaicsWidget.close() and SmartoaicsWidget.ask( text ).

Will my theme change how the chat looks?

No. The chat is drawn in its own isolated layer (Shadow DOM), so theme and page builder styles cannot change it. Its colors and texts are set in Settings, Chat widget.

Is it GDPR friendly?

Chats are stored in your own WordPress database, are deleted after the number of days you choose, and are included in the personal data export and erase tools. You can ask visitors to agree before chatting, and the plugin suggests text for your privacy policy. Messages are sent only to the AI provider you choose. Check your provider’s terms for where they process data.

Which LMS plugins are supported?

Tutor LMS and LearnPress. Developers can add more with the smartoaics_lms_drivers filter.

Can it change orders, give refunds or apply coupons?

No. It reads information and creates tickets for your team. It only shares the coupons you allow in Settings (none, all active store coupons, or the ones you pick), with their conditions, and never shows coupon descriptions.

Where are chats stored?

In your WordPress database. They are deleted automatically after the number of days you choose, and they are included in the WordPress personal data export and erase tools.

What visitor details does it store?

When a chat starts: browser and system names, device type, language, time zone and, where available, country. The country comes from your CDN or WooCommerce on your own site, without calling any outside service. The IP address is not stored, only a daily changing hash for rate limits. These details stay on your site, only your team sees them, and they are not sent to the AI provider. If you ask visitors for consent, nothing is collected until they agree. The plugin suggests text for your privacy policy under Settings, Privacy.
